verses.en: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,
As God liveth, who hath taken away my judgment; and the Almighty, who hath vexed my soul;
verses.sm: e le oti e o totoe ia te ia;

verses.en: All the while my breath is in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils;
My lips shall not speak wickedness, nor my tongue utter deceit.
God forbid that I should justify you: till I die I will not remove mine integrity from me.
verses.sm: fine ua oti a latou tane.

verses.en: My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go: my heart shall not reproach me so long as I live.
Let mine enemy be as the wicked, and he that riseth up against me as the unrighteous.
verses.sm: e ia o ario e pei o le efuefu,

verses.en: For what is the hope of the hypocrite, though he hath gained, when God taketh away his soul?
Will God hear his cry when trouble cometh upon him?
verses.sm: fu e pei o le omea;

verses.en: Will he delight himself in the Almighty? will he always call upon God?
I will teach you by the hand of God: that which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.
Behold, all ye yourselves have seen it; why then are ye thus altogether vain?
This is the portion of a wicked man with God, and the heritage of oppressors, which they shall receive of the Almighty.
verses.sm: e tufatufa foi ario e le ua sao lana amio.

verses.en: If his children be multiplied, it is for the sword: and his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.
Those that remain of him shall be buried in death: and his widows shall not weep.
verses.sm: na fale e pei o se pepe,

verses.en: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare raiment as the clay;
He may prepare it, but the just shall put it on, and the innocent shall divide the silver.
He buildeth his house as a moth, and as a booth that the keeper maketh.
The rich man shall lie down, but he shall not be gathered: he openeth his eyes, and he is not.
verses.sm: E taoto le mauoa, a e le faaopoopoina atu i ona tama; e pupula ona mata, ona leai ai lea o ia.

verses.en: Terrors take hold on him as waters, a tempest stealeth him away in the night.
verses.sm: E oo atu ia te ia mea matautia e pei o vai, e avea O ia e le asiosio i le po.

verses.en: The east wind carrieth him away, and he departeth: and as a storm hurleth him out of his place.
verses.sm: E lelea o ia e le matagi mai sasae, ona alu ai lea; e matua lelea ese ai o ia i le mea sa nofo ai.

verses.en: For God shall cast upon him, and not spare: he would fain flee out of his hand.
verses.sm: E faaoo e le Atua ia mea ia te ia, a e le faasaoina; e matua fia sola ese ia i lona aao.

verses.en: Men shall clap their hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place.
verses.sm: E pati lima tagata ia te ia, ma tuliuisa ia te ia ai le mea e nofo ai o ia.
